Zoe: Quick heads-up  Helio Solutions is live via the Azure Marketplace ISV Private Offer on Redwood Dedicated (westeurope) as of 15:05 UTC. Nice cross-team effort. :tada:
Arman: Sweet! Any early perf/cost notes?
Zoe: Early signals: p95 latency for document-extraction flows ~130ms at ~110 req/s. Estimated infra token cost down ~52% after int8 quantization + KV prefix caching.
Arman: Deploy trace:
```
[15:02:10] provision pool: helio-ded-03
[15:03:40] canary 5% -> health ok
[15:05:02] promote -> 100% traffic
[15:05:15] post-checks ok
```
LegalBot: Reminder: obtain written permission before publishing customer name/quote.
Marketing: I'll send the permission template and request a short quote + logo. Can someone drop a 1-paragraph blurb and one metric we can use for the marketplace tile?
Zoe: Draft blurb: "Helio Solutions reduced inference costs by ~52% and saw improved tail latency for document extraction workflows after moving to Redwood Dedicated via Azure Marketplace."
Arman: Add the model/config callout: `redwood-gpt-7b-1.1`, `kv_cache: prefix`, `quantization: int8`. Also confirm cross-region backup is enabled.
Zoe: Cross-region failover to eastus2 enabled; audit logs exported to customer's KMS.
Marketing: Great. Once legal signs off on the quote, I'll draft the public case tile and coordinate with Marketplace ops. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Arman: Thanks all. Please drop perf graphs or screenshots to this thread for the case study assets. I'll schedule an exec brief with the account team next week.
